**Likely enzyme: kynureninase (EC 3.7.1.3), a pyridoxal-5′-phosphate (PLP)-dependent enzyme.**

Its principal reaction is:

**L-kynurenine + H₂O → anthranilate + L-alanine + H⁺**  
(Rhea: RHEA:16813)

Close reviewed homologs are also annotated to catalyze:

**3-hydroxy-L-kynurenine + H₂O → 3-hydroxyanthranilate + L-alanine + H⁺**  
(Rhea: RHEA:25143)

This assignment is supported by strong sequence similarity to reviewed bacterial kynureninases—about 50–52% identity across roughly 99% of the sequence. It is a homology-based functional prediction; the supplied protein itself was not experimentally assayed.
